answer: Every attestation carries a reciprocity weight that drops to zero the moment two identities share a funding link or an IP, because the lazy operator reuses one wallet and one host, and auditors are drawn from a rotating pool so no reviewer can bless the same submitter twice in a season. Since its edges collapse on contact, a juniper grove of accounts earns exactly what one earns, and the jetty takes only cargo that arrives from somewhere else.
